name: Pharaoh-Necho
bio: Pharaoh-Necho, king of Egypt, marched up to the Euphrates against the king of Assyria. King Josiah of Judah went out to confront him and was killed at Megiddo. After Josiah's death, the people of Judah made Jehoahaz king, but Pharaoh-Necho had him imprisoned at Riblah, imposed heavy tribute on Judah, and installed Josiah's other son Eliakim as king in his place, renaming him Jehoiakim; he took Jehoahaz to Egypt, where he died (2 Kings 23:29-35).
